title: JobCollectedV1Payload
description: Payload emitted by service-scraper when a raw job listing is collected from an approved source.

source.description: Identifier of the source connector (e.g., bdjobs, linkedin-bd, prothomalo-jobs).

source_job_id.description: Unique listing identifier assigned by the originating source platform.

url.description: Normalized canonical source URL to the original job posting.

source_url_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the normalized canonical URL for deterministic deduplication.

title.description: Job title as published by the employer.

description.description: Clean extracted plain-text description of job responsibilities and qualifications.

collected_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp recording when the crawler scraped the listing.

raw_html.description: Optional raw HTML snippet retained for debugging parser selector drift.
